purpose: Test whether matching train/inference word boundaries and retaining negative association evidence improves actual pinyin candidate ranking.
data: Reuse only the pinned E54 background counts, segmented public training text and E53 current-production candidate exports. No new corpus, no count changes, no evaluation text in tokenizer vocabulary. Keep all E54 calibration-family/heldout exclusions and per-sentence attribution.
tokenizer: Keep every word on an E54 background Viterbi path plus each background Han singleton. Preserve original F1 SPLX/3 projected dictionary scores and unknown score exactly, with the same longest-first tie break and max 8 Han word length. Verify all 85502 background paths exactly after compact serialization. This guarantees observed training path preservation, not unseen-text equivalence to the full dictionary.
feature: W2 adjacent words and CW exact last zero-to-two editor Han characters to the first candidate word, divided by sqrt(candidate Han length). Aligned variants retokenize candidate text with the frozen compact tokenizer; path variants use the original winning path. Candidate text is segmented independently of truncated editor context, so oracle-context suffix boundaries are not claimed to equal full-sentence training boundaries.
signed: For retained pairs use log(((count-0.75)/contextTotal + backoff*prior)/prior), clipped to [-4,4]. For an unseen pair in a retained context use clipped log(backoff); unknown contexts contribute zero. Positive controls use only retained max(0,clipped log ratio), and unseen pairs contribute zero. No BOS/EOS or new sentence-end reward. This is a bounded association residual, not a normalized sentence language model.
fit: Fit each diagnostic variant once with the same E53 calibration groups and one scalar in [0,4], gold cross entropy, cap 8 tanh residual, ridge 0.001, zero initialization, L-BFGS-B maxiter 200 ftol 1e-10 gtol 1e-7. No sweep, no dev-driven model selection, no retry on quality failure. Freeze all four fits before reading dev rankings.
protection: Keep existing first-eight equal-length Han BASE_EXACT/BASE_COMPOSED slot rule. Before any scoring, preserve entire order when any eligible path has a nonzero PERSONAL_BASE/FLOOR/ADJUSTMENT component or a personal-only null-weight lexical edge. Require an explicit provenance flag from the audited raw winning path. These host diagnostics cannot prove absence of exactly cancelling known-word personalization; any future Android integration requires explicit runtime provenance, not the diagnostic observer.
gate: Require exact training tokenizer paths, fit convergence, combined tokenizer+count JSON <=16MiB, each known dev domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall identical and character errors nonincreasing, combined top1 strictly increasing, host additional scoring P95 <=100ms. Coverage is diagnostic, not a gate. Show all first gains/losses and full-sentence versus oracle-context suffix metrics. Only aligned-signed may proceed to independent regression and Android integration.
boundary: Do not alter production source/assets, APK, original signing material or use a physical phone in this offline stage. A host result does not establish Android latency, memory or UI correctness. Preserve all failures and leave the broad goal active.
